# `silk/utf8_decoder`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Profiles: `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`.

Incremental UTF-8 decoding across byte-chunk boundaries without allocation.

## When to use

Use [`Utf8Decoder`](#declaration-73696c6b2f757466385f6465636f6465723a3a557466384465636f646572) when bytes arrive in chunks and a sequence can cross a chunk boundary.
Use `String.fromUtf8` when all bytes are available in one complete slice.

## Details

Feed bytes in order with [`step`](#declaration-73696c6b2f757466385f6465636f6465723a3a557466384465636f6465722e73746570). A complete scalar resets the decoder for the next byte.
The caller supplies each byte's offset so an invalid result identifies that byte.

## Gotchas

If input ends while [`pending`](#declaration-73696c6b2f757466385f6465636f6465723a3a557466384465636f6465722e70656e64696e67) returns true, the caller must report incomplete input.
After an invalid result, create a new decoder before processing more bytes.

Import as `Utf8Decoder` with `import silk.utf8_decoder { Utf8Decoder }`.

Public declarations: 2.

## `Utf8Decoder`

```silk
pub struct Utf8Decoder
```

Allocation-free state for one UTF-8 scalar at a time across byte chunks.

### Details

A completed scalar leaves this state ready for the next sequence. An incomplete sequence
remains available for the next chunk. This state does not retain a byte slice.

<a id="declaration-73696c6b2f757466385f6465636f6465723a3a557466384465636f6465722e6d616b65"></a>

### Method `Utf8Decoder.step`

```silk
pub fn step<'life0>(self: &'life0 mut silk/utf8_decoder.Utf8Decoder, byte: u8, offset: usize) -> Utf8Step
```

Validates one byte and returns a scalar, a need-more result, or the invalid byte offset.

#### Details

Supply consecutive bytes in order, including across chunk boundaries. `offset` is the
absolute position of `byte` in the caller's input. A complete scalar resets the decoder.

#### Gotchas

Overlong sequences, surrogate values, and values above `0x10FFFF` are invalid. If input
ends while [`pending`](#declaration-73696c6b2f757466385f6465636f6465723a3a557466384465636f6465722e70656e64696e67) is true, the caller must report incomplete input.
